# MBK Global

MBK Global is an all-in-one web utility created by Muhammad Bakhtawar Khan. It fetches public video metadata and offers only provider-declared, verified MP4 video downloads when supported.

## Key pages

- https://[YOUR_DOMAIN]/ — MP4 video downloader and FAQ.
- https://[YOUR_DOMAIN]/profile — Muhammad Bakhtawar Khan profile, official social links, and visual collection.

## Important behavior

- MBK Global does not create fake results, ZIP files, audio-only alternatives, or converted streams.
- Downloads are available only for public media where an original provider MP4 URL is returned.
- Users should download only content they own or are authorized to download.
